sheet.name: Pumpkinhead Monstrosities

traits.name: Sinister Saplings
traits.text:
Saplings are Mobs with the same To Hit [To Hit] as Pumpkinheads and the Lumbering Basic Ability. When a Sapling is about to be activated, it performs Signature instead of AI.

The Clash starts with 6 two-sided BP cards on the Mob track. Those BPs do not Escalate. You cannot flip them using abilities. The Seed side represents a Sapling, the other one a Pumpkinhead.

When you wound a Sapling, discard its token and place its BP card on the Wound Stack. Then, Escalate the AI deck.

Pumpkinhead Monstrosities use special AI Escalation rules: Search the AI deck and AI discard pile for a card with a Level matching the number of Generic tokens on the wounded BP card and remove that AI card from the Clash. Then take a random AI card of one Level higher than the discarded AI card and shuffle it into the AI deck. If there is only one card in the AI deck or you remove a card from the discard pile, shuffle the discard pile into the deck.

traits.name: Cursed Overgrowth
traits.text:
When you wound a Pumpkinhead, instead of placing the wounded BP card on the Wound Stack, flip it and place a Generic token on it. Draw the top Fool’s deck card and place the Red Sapling token with the same number as that Pumpkinhead on the designated space. If that space is occupied by another miniature, place the Sapling token adjacent to that space.

Whenever you flip a BP card with Generic tokens on it, move those tokens to the other side.

Fast Regrowth: Discard all Green Sapling tokens from the designated Zone and place corresponding Pumpkinhead miniatures on those spaces. Flip corresponding BP cards to the Pumpkinhead side. Resolve additional instructions from the Kingdom Trait card (see Setup). Then, flip all Red Sapling tokens to the Green side.

traits.name: Ecological Cataclysm
traits.text:
Every Generic token on a BP card increases its AT [AT] by 1.
When there are 4 Generic tokens on any BP, you lose the Clash.

traits.name: Invasive Species
traits.text: The Pumpkinhead Monstrosities Setup changes depending on the Kingdom. See your Kingdom Book for Setup instructions.

traits.name: Controlled Burn
traits.text: Saplings can’t be Wounded unless there is at least 1 Fire [Fire] token in the Knight Pool.

traits.name: Fire Walk with Me
traits.text:
When a Pumpkinhead moves onto a Campfire Terrain tile, it immediately dies (treat it as wounded). If that Pumpkinhead was the Target of an Attack, proceed to Monster Responses. Otherwise, at the end of the current action, flip its BP card and place a Generic token on it. Place a Generic Single Wound on the Wound Stack. Escalate the AI deck. Then remove its miniature from the Board and place a new Red Sapling according to the regular rules.
Level 2+: Place 2 Generic tokens on the new Sapling’s BP card.

traits.name: Spore Spreader
traits.text: After resolving Fast Regrowth, all new Pumpkinheads perform Signature (one by one).

traits.name: Pumpkin Plague
traits.text:
Each time you deal a Wound to a Pumpkinhead or a Sapling token, place a Generic token on one of your Gear [Gear] cards. Limit 1 token per Gear [Gear] card, 2 tokens per 2-handed Weapon [Gear] card. You cannot place Generic tokens on Upgrade cards.
If you would have to place a Generic token on a Gear [Gear] card, and all your Gear [Gear] cards already have the maximum number of Generic tokens, you are overtaken by Pumpkinhead seedlings and become one of them (you die). After you finish resolving your Attack, Heal 1 and place a new Pumpkinhead miniature on your space.
Squires gain Bane [Bane] tokens instead. When a Squire dies as a result of Bane, Heal 1 and place a new Pumpkinhead miniature on their space.

traits.name: Accelerated Regrowth
traits.text: When you are about to place a Red Sapling token, place it Green side up instead.
